messages:
IncidentBot: PAGE ⛑️ High error rate (5xx) on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — automatic alert triggered. Pager: maya. PD: INC-4521.
Maya Chen: I'm on it. seeing ~30% 5xx across a/b pools. Rolling back the last deploy to canary now.
Diego Ramos: FYI I see increased latency from the kv-cache tier too, could be related.
Maya Chen: rollback started. `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/generator-canary` — watching logs.
Priya Nair: tagging the affected customers in support. Notifying enterprise customers with high qps.
Sam Lee: I'm joining — Sam oncall takeover in 10. if rollback doesn't bring down error rate, escalate to infra.
Maya Chen: rollback completed, canary pods went to ready. 5xx dropped to ~3% (from 30%). still seeing some tail errors.
Diego Ramos: tail errors are from long-context requests hitting kv-miss fallback path. adding temporary rate limit for >16k token requests.
Maya Chen: applied limiter on the edge: `nginx rate-limit: if req.len>16000 deny`. should reduce pressure.
Priya Nair: Support update posted to #customers: "We're investigating an error affecting generation in US-WEST; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA." :eyes:
Sam Lee: good mitigation. Hands off to me for the stability window. Maya, can you add the rollback commit hash to the incident ticket?
Maya Chen: added: revert commit 0a9f4b2.
Alex Park: Product tracking: which SLAs could be impacted? Estimated affected requests: ~0.4% of global traffic but concentrated on a few high-QPS enterprise tenants in us-west.
Priya Nair: Noted. Customer A and Customer C saw increased failures; support is escalating. Sending template email now.
Sam Lee: Next steps for this on-call shift: 1) monitor error rate for 2h, 2) capture logs and traces for pre-rollback window, 3) schedule postmortem tomorrow, 4) collect a minimal reproducer.
Maya Chen: I'll grab the traces and bucket them by request size and model variant. Posting initial logs here: ```
[2024-07-06T16:12:04Z] generator-canary stderr: KV cache miss, fetching from slow storage, timeout after 1200ms
[2024-07-06T16:12:04Z] generator-canary stderr: upstream 504
```
Diego Ramos: Looks like the new cache eviction policy in the last deploy increased cold miss rates under bursty backgrounds.
Sam Lee: Good call. We'll include eviction thresholds in the postmortem hypothesis. Also assign owners: Diego -> cache repro + fix, Maya -> postmortem draft + customer impact, Priya -> customer comms + RCA email, OpsInfra -> runbook update and autoscale tuning.
Maya Chen: Can we get a thread-based calendar invite for a 60-min postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT? I can chair.
Alex Park: I'll join to represent customer impact and help triage prioritization.
Priya Nair: Customer comms: sending follow-up to impacted customers now with interim mitigation and ETA for RCA.
IncidentBot: Reminder set: postmortem meeting scheduled 2024-07-07T17:00:00Z (10:00 PT). Link: https://meet.link/pm-4521
Sam Lee: For the postmortem agenda: timeline, impact, hypothesis, evidence, root cause, action items, owners, timeline for fix, and verification plan.
Diego Ramos: For the remediation plan I propose: 1) revert eviction param change, 2) add KV cache metrics/alert for miss-rate >5%, 3) add integration test that simulates bursty cold-start load.
Maya Chen: add: update the deploy checklist to include a brief canary perf test for cache-sensitive components.
OpsInfra: we'll add an autoscale buffer for canary pools and increase the cold-start cache pre-warm on rollout. I'll open infra tickets.
Priya Nair: Action items documented in INC-4521 in Jira. I'll assign deadlines: prelim RCA in 48h, code fix in 7 days, runbook & tests in 14 days.
Sam Lee: We'll do a short handoff note to the night on-call in #eng-oncall: summary + key metrics + links. Maya, can you post that before your shift ends?
Maya Chen: Yep posting now. Summary: rollback done, error rate dropped to baseline, mitigation: rollback + edge limiter, suspected cause: cache eviction policy change increasing cold misses. Links: INC-4521, traces, deploy diff.
Diego Ramos: I'm creating a branch with a reproduction harness; will ping when ready for review.
Alex Park: Suggestion: schedule a 45-minute brown-bag for the infra+prod teams to run through prevention patterns and how cache tuning affects LLM latency. Good cross-team learning.
Sam Lee: +1. Let's do a postmortem share-out 1 week after fix close. Maya / Diego can present technical details; product can present customer impact. OpsInfra to present runbook changes.
Priya Nair: I'll coordinate invites and a short slide template. Keep it practical: reproducible steps, testing checklist, and a short FAQ for support.
IncidentBot: Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x6, :eyes: x3, :party: x1.
Maya Chen: Thanks folks. Leaving notes in the incident ticket and will update the postmortem doc after the meeting. Sam, you're the owner for verification until fixed.
Sam Lee: On it. If anything regresses ping me directly. Good work on the fast rollback everyone.
Diego Ramos: One last note — let's add a pre-deploy perf test job in CI that runs a synthetic cold-cache burst. I'll draft the job spec.
Maya Chen: assigning Diego, Priya, OpsInfra in the action items list. Closing this thread for live mitigation — continuing on postmortem doc.
Priya Nair: Copy. I'll share the customer follow-up after the postmortem is published.
Sam Lee: Handoff complete. Night on-call team, accept.
Night Oncall: Accepted. We'll monitor and escalate if needed.
